Welcome.Desc: CodeWF.Toolkit demo shell: ribbon tabs, dock workspace, property grid and log panel covering 6 capability domains with 12 real-API pages.

Core.Desc: Dependency-free extensions and infrastructure: string/number/enum helpers, encoding detection and safe IO, app data migration, GitHub release update checking.

Bus.Desc: In-process event bus: publish/subscribe plus Command/Query, lambda and [EventHandler] scanning subscriptions, unsubscribe and assembly scanning.

BusIntegrations.Desc: One handler model, several hosts: Prism, ASP.NET Core, generic IOC and the cross-process Socket bus with heartbeat, reconnect and offline redelivery.

FilesFormat.Desc: Json / Yaml / Csv / Excel read-write and conversion; every extension reports failure through an out error parameter.

FilesArchive.Desc: SevenZipCompressor over SharpCompress: LZMA compression, UTF-8 entry names, remote URL packing; AppConfigHelper reads and writes appSettings.

ImageIcon.Desc: ImageHelper over Magick.NET: merge one PNG into a multi-size ico, or split sizes into separate ico files.

ImageQr.Desc: QrCodeGenerator over ZXing.Net.Bindings.Magick: produce a titled QR image that plugs straight into the Magick.NET pipeline.

LogCore.Desc: Static Logger: console, rolling files and a UI event feed, with batched async writes, live line-template updates and self diagnostics.

LogMicrosoft.Desc: Microsoft.Extensions.Logging provider: one AddCodeWF call keeps structured templates, scopes and Activity data, sharing the pipeline with the static Logger.

NetPacket.Desc: NetWeaver attribute-driven binary serialization: [NetHead] for the packet header, [NetFieldOrder] for wire order, big-endian and round-trip verified.

NetSocket.Desc: NetWrapper TCP/UDP wrappers with command dispatch and a built-in remote file system: 64KB chunks, hash verification, resume and progress events.
